speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) whether he can provide a current breakdown of the incidence of diabetes by income group; and (b) what strategies are being deployed to promote affordable healthier food products and cooked food options.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Our priority is to help Singaporeans from all walks of life to live healthily.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: This means to eat healthily, exercise regularly and go for routine health screening.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Healthier eating means being more discerning about our diet, reducing our intake of sugar, salt and fats, and eating moderate meal portions.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The Health Promotion Board (HPB) has rolled out various initiatives to inform the public of affordable, tasty and healthier food options.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: These include information on Healthy Meals, Healthy Hawker Hacks and Healthy Meals for the Entire Family.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Supermarkets have also made available affordable healthier options under their house brands.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: For example, in our local supermarkets, house brand wholemeal bread is cheaper than some brands of white bread.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: These bundles are donated by corporate donors to families in need, through the Food Bank's community partners.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: HPB is also working with voluntary welfare organisations, such as Free Food for All, involved in food donation drives to improve their menus with healthier food options, as well as with National Trades Union Congress SilverAce to organise regular cooking demonstrations on simple yet tasty healthier meals for their needy beneficiaries.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: In addition, we are looking at more ways to reach out to beneficiaries under the public assistance scheme to promote healthy living.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Healthy living is not just about healthier diet.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: It is also about adopting an active lifestyle and appropriate health screening.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We will continue our efforts to ensure that all Singaporeans can choose to live healthily.
